function_v0.doc:
Record a rating for a completed job.

- `caller` must be the registered scorer (the backend JobManager).
- `rating_0_to_100` is stored as basis points (\xc3\x97 100 \xe2\x86\x92 0..10_000).
- `weight` is the job's USDC value in stroops, 0 < weight \xe2\x89\xa4 MAX_WEIGHT.
- `(agent_id, job_id)` can only ever be rated once (persistent guard).
- `payer` accrues cumulative stake for off-chain Sybil analysis.
- `kind == "dispute"` additionally bumps the lifetime dispute counter.
function_v0.name: submit

function_v0.doc: View \xe2\x80\x94 decayed weighted mean in basis points (0..10_000, since\n`sum_w` already carries the \xc3\x97 100 scale). 0 when weight == 0.
function_v0.name: avg_bps

function_v0.doc:
View \xe2\x80\x94 Bayesian-smoothed mean:
`(prior_weight \xc3\x97 prior_bps + sum_w) / (prior_weight + weight)`.
The caller-supplied prior anchors low-evidence agents; as decayed
evidence weight grows the result converges to the raw mean.
Returns `prior_bps` when both weights are 0. Clamped to 0..10_000.
function_v0.name: rep_bps

function_v0.doc: View \xe2\x80\x94 the agent's RepState decayed to now (nothing is written).
function_v0.name: rep_state

function_v0.doc: View \xe2\x80\x94 cumulative (never decayed) weight this payer has contributed\nto this agent's reputation. 0 by default. Raw evidence for off-chain\nSybil / self-dealing analysis.
function_v0.name: payer_weight

function_v0.doc: View \xe2\x80\x94 lifetime dispute rate in basis points:\n`disputed \xc3\x97 10_000 / count`. 0 when count == 0. Never decayed.
function_v0.name: dispute_rate_bps
